description: This file defines the 'Res' class which provides utility static methods for managing HTTP cookies, headers, JSON responses, session handling, HTTP response codes, and redirection.

classes.name: Res
classes.description: Utility class offering static methods for handling web response elements like cookies, headers, sessions, and redirects.

methods.name: cookie
methods.description: Sets multiple cookies based on an associative array. Defaults to a 1-hour expiration if not specified.

methods.name: delcookie
methods.description: Deletes a cookie by setting its expiration in the past.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Sends a JSON response with appropriate content-type header.

methods.name: session
methods.description: Starts a session and sets multiple session variables from an array.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Sets the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the client to a specified URL with status code 302.
